title: Looking One Step Ahead: An Anticipation-guided Agent for Object State Readout in Videos
abstract: arXiv:2611.14113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding the progress of an activity requires tracking how the objects involved change over time. Object state readout provides this information by describing a target object's states and transitions across video frames. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate detailed visual descriptions, these descriptions may leave the attributes needed to distinguish successive states insufficiently specified. In this paper, we propose look-ahead state readout (LASER), an anticipation-guided agent for object state readout that uses possible next-step changes to determine which attributes to inspect in the present. Given temporally ordered frames and a target object, LASER converts anticipated changes into targeted visual questions and inspects the current frame to establish attribute values. translated_title: 前瞻一步：一种用于视频中物体状态读取的预判引导智能体
translated_abstract: 理解一项活动的进展需要追踪相关物体如何随时间变化。物体状态读取通过描述目标物体在视频各帧中的状态及其转换来提供这一信息。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够生成详细的视觉描述，但这些描述可能未能充分明确区分连续状态所需的属性。在本文中，我们提出了前瞻式状态读取（LASER），这是一种预判引导的物体状态读取智能体，它利用可能的下一步变化来确定当前应该检查哪些属性。给定按时间排序的视频帧和目标物体，LASER 将预期的变化转化为有针对性的视觉问题，并检查当前帧以确定属性值。随后，它将状态读取和预测结果与对后续帧的独立观察进行核对，从而不断完善用于生成状态记录的信息。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为LASER的预判引导智能体，通过预测物体下一步可能发生的变化来确定当前帧中需要重点检查的视觉属性，从而实现视频中物体状态及其转换的准确读取。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LASER, an anticipation-guided agent that determines which attributes to inspect in the current frame by anticipating possible next-step object changes, enabling accurate object state readout in videos.
